Example Data

Source: R/data.R
dat_example.Rd

A 5,000-organization sample of raw 990 efile fields (tax year 2022), used as a worked example for building features and running the factor model. Contains the Part IV, VI, and XII and Schedule M fields that get_features consumes, plus organization name / return type / tax year for illustration. Values are unmodified from the source (e.g. yes/no fields as "true"/"false", flags as "X", blanks as "").

Pulled directly from the NCCS 990 efile v2.1 archive; see data-raw/make-dat-example.R for the exact provenance and the efile v2.1 catalog.

Usage

dat_example

Format

An object of class data.frame with 5000 rows and 31 columns.
